steps.content:
Based on the information on those two pages, there is **no material difference** between the two sellers - you can buy from either.

Here is the comparison from the listings I checked:

**Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite

| Feature | Seller A: **Brackmoor Sound** | Seller B: **Ottervale Audio** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Stock / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Identical - 40h battery with ANC on, BT 5.3, 254g, headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable | Identical - 40h battery with ANC on, BT 5.3, 254g, headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable |

### Why no winner?

On every factor shown on the listing page - price, customer rating, shipping speed/cost, return policy, and warranty - they are identical.

So there is no price, service, or policy advantage to choosing one over the other based *only* on that page.

If you need a tie-breaker, you would have to look at information **not on these pages**, such as:
* Past experience you have with either seller
* External reviews of their customer service / warranty support / return ease
* Which payment methods you prefer

But on the listings themselves, **either seller is an equally good choice.**
